end

local function getPlayerRoot(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
        return nil
    end
    return root
end

local function isPlayerNear(position, distance)
    local distanceSquared = distance * distance
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local root = getPlayerRoot(player)
        if root then
            local offset = root.Position - position
            if offset:Dot(offset) <= distanceSquared then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function getGroundPosition(position)
    local ok, groundPosition = pcall(function()
        return MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0))
    end)
    if ok and groundPosition then
        return groundPosition
    end

    local safePosition = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(position)
    return safePosition or position
end

local function createMarker(state)
    local marker = Instance.new("Model")
    marker.Name = "GearSourceMarker_" .. tostring(state.config.id)
    marker.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local root = Instance.new("Part")
    root.Name = "Root"
    root.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    root.Anchored = true
    root.CanCollide = false
    root.CanTouch = false
    root.CanQuery = false
    root.Transparency = 1
    root.Parent = marker

    marker.PrimaryPart = root
    marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceId", state.config.id)
    marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
    marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceVisible", revealed)
    marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceZone", state.config.zoneLevel)
    CollectionService:AddTag(marker, SOURCE_MARKER_TAG)
    marker:PivotTo(CFrame.new(state.spawnCFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)))
    marker.Parent = markerFolder

    state.marker = marker
end

local function setSourceState(state, stateName, position)
    state.stateName = stateName
    state.source:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", stateName)
    if state.marker and state.marker.Parent then
        state.marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", stateName)
        if position then
            state.marker:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)))
        end
    end
end

local function destroyGuards(state)
    if not state.guards then
        return
    end

    for _, guard in ipairs(state.guards) do
        if guard and guard.Parent then
            guard:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(state.guards)
    state.source:SetAttribute("AliveGuards", 0)
end

local function spawnGuards(state)
    local source = state.source
    local config = state.config
    local _, bounds = source:GetBoundingBox()
    local radius = math.max(bounds.X, bounds.Z) * 0.5 + config.guardPadding
    local center = source:GetPivot().Position
    local guards = {}

    for index = 1, config.guardCount do
        local angle = (index - 1) / config.guardCount * math.pi * 2
        local localOffset = CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -radius)
        local requestedPosition = center + source:GetPivot().Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(localOffset.Position)
        local groundPosition = getGroundPosition(requestedPosition)
        local enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(config.guardEnemyId, guardFolder)

        if enemy then
            enemy:SetAttribute("GearSourceId", config.id)
            enemy:SetAttribute("GearSourceGuard", true)
            enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(groundPosition + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), center))
            table.insert(guards, enemy)
        else
            warn("[GearSourceService] Failed to create guard", config.guardEnemyId, "for source", config.id)
        end
    end

    state.guards = guards
    state.source:SetAttribute("AliveGuards", #guards)
end

local function findSourceGear(state)
    for _, gear in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Gear)) do
        if gear:GetAttribute("GearSourceId") == state.config.id
            and gear:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            and not gear:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")) then
            return gear
        end
    end
end

local function activateSource(state)
    if state.activated or state.activating or state.cleaned then
        return
    end

    state.activating = true
    state.gear = state.gear or findSourceGear(state)
    if not state.gear then
        state.activating = false
        warn("[GearSourceService] Missing NatureRes Gear for source", state.config.id)
        return
    end
    spawnGuards(state)
    state.activated = true
    state.activating = false
    state.source:SetAttribute("GearSourceActivated", true)
    state.source:SetAttribute("GearSourceGearId", state.config.gearItemId)
    setSourceState(state, "Guarded", state.spawnCFrame.Position)
end

local function recoverGear(state)
    local gear = state.gear
    if not gear or not gear.Parent or gear:GetAttribute("GearMechanismConsumed") then
        return
    end

    local ok = pcall(function()
        gear:PivotTo(state.spawnCFrame)
        gear:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag)
        gear.Parent = workspace
        if gear.PrimaryPart then
            gear.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
        end
    end)

    if ok then
        gear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
        setSourceState(state, "Guarded", state.spawnCFrame.Position)
    end
end

local function isOutsideMap(position)
    if position.Y < -200 then
        return true
    end

    local ok, gridX, gridZ = pcall(function()
        return MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position)
    end)
    if not ok or not gridX or not gridZ then
        return false
    end

    return not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(gridX, gridZ)
end

local function updateGearState(state)
    local gear = state.gear
    if not gear then
        return
    end

    if gear:GetAttribute("GearMechanismConsumed") then
        gear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Installed")
        setSourceState(state, "Installed", state.spawnCFrame.Position)
        return
    end

    if not gear.Parent then
        return
    end

    if gear:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) then
        local owner = BagHelper:GetInWhoBag(gear)
        local ownerRoot = owner and getPlayerRoot(owner)
        if ownerRoot then
            setSourceState(state, "InTransit", ownerRoot.Position)
        else
            recoverGear(state)
        end
        gear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "InTransit")
        return
    end

    local position = gear:GetPivot().Position
    if isOutsideMap(position) then
        recoverGear(state)
        return
    end

    local distance = (position - state.spawnCFrame.Position).Magnitude
    if distance > state.config.recoveryDistance then
        gear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "InTransit")
        setSourceState(state, "InTransit", position)
    else
        gear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
        setSourceState(state, "Guarded", state.spawnCFrame.Position)
    end
end

local function revealSources()
    if revealed then
        return
    end

    revealed = true
    workspace:SetAttribute("GearSourcesRevealed", true)
    sourceFolder:SetAttribute("GearSourcesRevealed", true)

    for _, state in pairs(states) do
        if state.marker and state.marker.Parent then
            state.marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceVisible", true)
        end
    end
end

local function syncRevealMarkers()
    if not revealed then
        return
    end

    for _, marker in ipairs(markerFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if marker:IsA("Model") then
            marker:SetAttribute("GearSourceVisible", true)
        end
    end
end

local function checkWorkshopArrival()
    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
    local distanceSquared = WORKSHOP_DISCOVERY_DISTANCE * WORKSHOP_DISCOVERY_DISTANCE

    for _, workshop in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(WeaponWorkshopSetting.WorkshopTag)) do
        if not workshop:IsA("Model")
            or not workshop:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            or (prefabs and workshop:IsDescendantOf(prefabs)) then
            continue
        end

        local position = workshop:GetPivot().Position
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if notifiedUserIds[player.UserId] then
                continue
            end

            local root = getPlayerRoot(player)
            if root then
                local offset = root.Position - position
                if offset:Dot(offset) <= distanceSquared then
                    notifiedUserIds[player.UserId] = true
                    revealSources()
                    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, WORKSHOP_DISCOVERY_TIP)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function cleanupSource(state)
    if state.cleaned then
        return
    end

    state.cleaned = true
    destroyGuards(state)

    if state.marker and state.marker.Parent then
        state.marker:Destroy()
    end

    states[state.source] = nil
end

local function bindSource(source)
    if not source:IsA("Model") or states[source] then
        return
    end

    local sourceId = source:GetAttribute("GearSourceId")
    local config = sourceId and GearSourceSetting:GetById(sourceId)
    if not config then
        return
    end

    local spawnCFrame = source:GetAttribute("GearSpawnCFrame")
    if typeof(spawnCFrame) ~= "CFrame" then
        warn("[GearSourceService] Missing GearSpawnCFrame:", source:GetFullName())
        return
    end

    local state = {
        source = source,
        config = config,
        spawnCFrame = spawnCFrame,
        marker = nil,
        gear = nil,
        guards = {},
        activated = false,
        activating = false,
        stateName = "Guarded",
        cleaned = false,
    }
    states[source] = state
    source:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
    source:SetAttribute("GearSourceActivated", false)
    source:SetAttribute("AliveGuards", 0)
    createMarker(state)

    source.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            cleanupSource(state)
        end
    end)
end

sourceFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(source)
    task.defer(bindSource, source)
end)

for _, source in ipairs(sourceFolder:GetChildren()) do
    task.defer(bindSource, source)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    for _, state in pairs(states) do
        local gear = state.gear
        local bagStore = workspace:FindFirstChild("BagStore_" .. tostring(player.UserId))
        if gear and bagStore and gear:IsDescendantOf(bagStore) then
            recoverGear(state)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime < nextStepTime then
        return
    end
    nextStepTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.5

    checkWorkshopArrival()
    syncRevealMarkers()

    for _, state in pairs(states) do
        if state.cleaned or not state.source.Parent then
            cleanupSource(state)
            continue
        end

        if not state.gear then
            state.gear = findSourceGear(state)
        end

        if not state.activated and isPlayerNear(state.source:GetPivot().Position, state.config.activationDistance) then
            activateSource(state)
        end

        if state.activated then
            updateGearState(state)
        end
    end
end)
"},{"id":351,"text":"local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local HitReactionHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("HitReactionHelper"))

local effectFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Effect")
local playRemote = effectFolder:WaitForChild("PlayHitReactionS2C")

local MAX_DISTANCE = 120
local MAX_DISTANCE_SQUARED = MAX_DISTANCE * MAX_DISTANCE
local MAX_BATCH_PER_PLAYER = 12
local TARGET_INTERVAL = HitReactionHelper.GetTargetInterval()

local playerRoots = {}
local characterConnections = {}
local removingConnections = {}
local pendingByPlayer = {}
local flushScheduled = false
local targetStates = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local AnimalBuddyValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.AnimalBuddyValue

local function getRoot(player)
    local root = playerRoots[player]
    if root and root.Parent then
        return root
    end
    local character = player.Character
    local candidate = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
        playerRoots[player] = candidate
        return candidate
    end
    return nil
end

local function disconnectCharacter(player)
    local connection = characterConnections[player]
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
        characterConnections[player] = nil
    end
    local removingConnection = removingConnections[player]
    if removingConnection then
        removingConnection:Disconnect()
        removingConnections[player] = nil
    end
end

local function cacheCharacter(player, character)
    playerRoots[player] = nil
    if not character then
        return
    end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
        playerRoots[player] = root
    else
        task.defer(function()
            if player.Character == character then
                local deferredRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if deferredRoot and deferredRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
                    playerRoots[player] = deferredRoot
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function watchPlayer(player)
    disconnectCharacter(player)
    cacheCharacter(player, player.Character)
    characterConnections[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        cacheCharacter(player, character)
    end)
    removingConnections[player] = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
        if player.Character == character or playerRoots[player] and playerRoots[player].Parent == character then
            playerRoots[player] = nil
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    disconnectCharacter(player)
    playerRoots[player] = nil
    pendingByPlayer[player] = nil
end)

local function getPlayerFromAttacker(attacker)
    if not attacker then
        return nil
    end
    if attacker:IsA("Player") then
        return attacker
    end
    if not attacker:IsA("Model") then
        return nil
    end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attacker)
    if player then
        return player
    end
    if attacker:HasTag("AnimalBuddy") then
        return ValueHelper:FindValueValue(attacker, AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
    end
    return nil
end

local function getTargetState(target)
    local state = targetStates[target]
    if not state then
        state = {
            lastSentAt = 0,
            lastWasCritical = false,
        }
        targetStates[target] = state
    end
    return state
end

local function canQueueTarget(target, critical)
    local state = getTargetState(target)
    local now = os.clock()
    if critical then
        return true
    end
    return now - state.lastSentAt >= TARGET_INTERVAL
end

local function markTargetSent(target, critical)
    local state = getTargetState(target)
    state.lastSentAt = os.clock()
    state.lastWasCritical = critical
end

local function insertOrReplacePending(player, record)
    local list = pendingByPlayer[player]
    if not list then
        list = {}
        pendingByPlayer[player] = list
    end

    for index, existing in ipairs(list) do
        if existing.Target == record.Target then
            if record.Critical and not existing.Critical then
                list[index] = record
            elseif record.Critical and existing.Critical then
                list[index] = record
            end
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(list, record)
end

local function scheduleFlush()
    if flushScheduled then
        return
    end
    flushScheduled = true
    task.defer(function()
        flushScheduled = false
        for player, records in pairs(pendingByPlayer) do
            pendingByPlayer[player] = nil
            if player.Parent ~= Players then
                continue
            end

            table.sort(records, function(a, b)
                if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then
                    return a.Critical
                end
                if a.Guaranteed ~= b.Guaranteed then
                    return a.Guaranteed
                end
                return a.DistanceScore > b.DistanceScore
            end)

            local packets = {}
            local packetCount = math.min(#records, MAX_BATCH_PER_PLAYER)
            for index = 1, packetCount do
                local record = records[index]
                table.insert(packets, {
                    Target = record.Target,
                    Position = record.Position,
                    Direction = record.Direction,
                    Variant = record.Variant,
                    Critical = record.Critical,
                })
                markTargetSent(record.Target, record.Critical)
            end

            if #packets > 0 then
                playRemote:FireClient(player, packets)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function queueForRecipients(target, position, direction, variant, critical, attackerPlayer, targetPlayer)
    local recipients = {}
    if attackerPlayer then
        recipients[attackerPlayer] = true
    end
    if targetPlayer then
        recipients[targetPlayer] = true
    end

    for player, root in pairs(playerRoots) do
        if player.Parent == Players and root and root.Parent then
            local delta = root.Position - position
            if delta:Dot(delta) <= MAX_DISTANCE_SQUARED then
                recipients[player] = true
            end
        end
    end

    for player in pairs(recipients) do
        local root = getRoot(player)
        local distanceScore = 0
        if root then
            local delta = root.Position - position
            distanceScore = -delta:Dot(delta)
        end
        local guaranteed = player == attackerPlayer or player == targetPlayer
        if canQueueTarget(target, critical) then
            insertOrReplacePending(player, {
                Target = target,
                Position = position,
                Direction = direction,
                Variant = variant,
                Critical = critical,
                Guaranteed = guaranteed,
                DistanceScore = distanceScore,
            })
        end
    end

    if next(recipients) then
        scheduleFlush()
    end
end

local function processDamage(attacker, target, damage, damageSource, context, targetPlayer)
    if not HitReactionHelper.IsEnabled() then
        return
    end
    if not HitReactionHelper.ShouldPlay(attacker, target, damage, damageSource, context) then
        return
    end

    local position = HitReactionHelper.ResolvePosition(target, context)
    if not HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
        return
    end

    local direction = HitReactionHelper.ResolveDirection(attacker, target, context, position)
    local critical = context and context.IsCritical == true
    local variant = HitReactionHelper.ChooseVariant(target, critical)
    local attackerPlayer = getPlayerFromAttacker(attacker)
    queueForRecipients(target, position, direction, variant, critical, attackerPlayer, targetPlayer)
end

for _, effectName in ipairs({"Punch-01", "Punch-02", "Punch-03"}) do
    if not workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):FindFirstChild(effectName) then
        warn("[HitReaction] Missing effect prefab: " .. effectName)
    end
end

GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(attacker, npc, damage, damageSource, context)
    processDamage(attacker, npc, damage, damageSource, context, nil)
end)

GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(player, damage, attacker, context)
    processDamage(attacker, player.Character, damage, context and context.DamageSource, context, player)
end)
"},{"id":352,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local src = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src")
local GameEnum = require(src:WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(src:WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(src:WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(src:WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(src:WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local Setting = require(src:WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("WeaponWorkshopSetting"))

local DragItemValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.DragItemValue
local PlayerValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue

local boundWorkshops = {}

local function trackConnection(state, connection)
	state.connections[connection] = true
	return connection
end

local function disconnectConnection(state, connection)
	if not connection then
		return
	end
	state.connections[connection] = nil
	connection:Disconnect()
end

local function playEffect(name, emitter)
	pcall(function()
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect(name, emitter)
	end)
end

local function startTween(state, instance, tweenInfo, properties)
	if state.destroyed or not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return nil
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, tweenInfo, properties)
	state.tweens[tween] = true
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

local function finishTween(state, tween, instance, properties)
	if tween then
		state.tweens[tween] = nil
	end
	if state.destroyed or not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return false
	end
	for property, value in pairs(properties) do
		instance[property] = value
	end
	return true
end

local function getBaseParts(item)
	local parts = {}
	if item:IsA("BasePart") then
		table.insert(parts, item)
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, descendant)
		end
	end
	return parts
end

local function getResourceItem(instance)
	local success, item = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(instance)
	if success then
		return item
	end
	return nil
end

local function getItemId(item)
	local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
	return lo and lo.id or nil
end

local function hasValidSubmittingPlayer(item)
	local player = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLastDragPlayer(item)
	return player and player:IsA("Player") and player.Parent == Players
end

local function showUnpoweredTip(state, item)
	local player = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLastDragPlayer(item)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local lastAt = state.unpoweredTipAtByPlayer[player]
	if lastAt and now - lastAt < Setting.UnpoweredTipCooldown then
		return
	end

	state.unpoweredTipAtByPlayer[player] = now
	UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, Setting.UnpoweredTipText, UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
end

local function isLooseDraggableResource(item)
	local enableValue = item and ValueHelper:FindValue(item, DragItemValue.enable) or nil
	return item
		and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
		and item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ResourcesItem)
		and item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
		and enableValue
		and enableValue.Value == true
		and not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag)
		and not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Equipped)
end

local function getMaterialContribution(machine, item)
	if not isLooseDraggableResource(item) then
		return nil
	end

	local requirement = machine and machine.requirement or nil
	local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
	if not requirement or not lo then
		return nil
	end
	if requirement.MatchItemId ~= nil and lo.id ~= requirement.MatchItemId then
		return nil
	end
	if requirement.MatchItemType ~= nil and lo.ItemType ~= requirement.MatchItemType then
		return nil
	end
	if requirement.MatchItemId == nil and requirement.MatchItemType == nil then
		return nil
	end

	if requirement.CountMode == "Entity" then
		return 1
	end
	if requirement.CountMode == "Param" then
		local amount = tonumber(lo.param)
		if not amount or amount <= 0 then
			return nil
		end
		return math.max(1, math.floor(amount))
	end
	return nil
end

local function reserveItem(item, token)
	if item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute) ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	item:SetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute, token)
	return item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute) == token
end

local function clearReservation(item, token)
	if item and item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute) == token then
		item:SetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute, nil)
	end
end

local function releaseCurrentDrag(item)
	local dragPlayerValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(item, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
	local player = dragPlayerValue and dragPlayerValue.Value or nil
	if dragPlayerValue then
		dragPlayerValue.Value = nil
	end
	if player and player:IsA("Player") then
		local playerDragValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player, PlayerValue.dragItem)
		if playerDragValue and playerDragValue.Value == item then
			playerDragValue.Value = nil
		end
	end
end

local function lockItem(state, item)
	if state.lockedItems[item] then
		return state.lockedItems[item]
	end

	local parts = getBaseParts(item)
	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local enableValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(item, DragItemValue.enable)
	local record = {
		wasDraggable = item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem),
		enableValue = enableValue,
		wasEnabled = enableValue and enableValue.Value or nil,
		parts = {},
	}
	state.lockedItems[item] = record

	if enableValue then
		enableValue.Value = false
	end
	releaseCurrentDrag(item)
	if record.wasDraggable then
		item:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		record.parts[part] = {
			Anchored = part.Anchored,
			CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
			CanTouch = part.CanTouch,
			CanQuery = part.CanQuery,
			CFrame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Transparency = part.Transparency,
			LinearVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
			AngularVelocity = part.AssemblyAngularVelocity,
		}
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
	end

	return record
end

local function unlockItem(state, item, restoreTransforms, token)
	local record = state.lockedItems[item]
	if not record then
		clearReservation(item, token)
		return
	end
	state.lockedItems[item] = nil

	for part, snapshot in pairs(record.parts) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.Size = snapshot.Size
			part.Transparency = snapshot.Transparency
			if restoreTransforms then
				part.CFrame = snapshot.CFrame
			end
			part.CanCollide = snapshot.CanCollide
			part.CanTouch = snapshot.CanTouch
			part.CanQuery = snapshot.CanQuery
			part.Anchored = snapshot.Anchored
			if not snapshot.Anchored then
				part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = snapshot.LinearVelocity
				part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = snapshot.AngularVelocity
			end
		end
	end

	clearReservation(item, token)
	if record.enableValue and record.enableValue.Parent and record.wasEnabled ~= nil then
		record.enableValue.Value = record.wasEnabled
	end
	if record.wasDraggable
		and item.Parent
		and ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item)
		and not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
	then
		item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
	end
end

local function discardLockedItem(state, item)
	state.lockedItems[item] = nil
end

local function pivotTween(state, item, targetCFrame, duration)
	if state.destroyed or not item or not item.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local driver = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	driver.Value = item:GetPivot()
	local connection
	connection = driver:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		if not state.destroyed and item.Parent then
			item:PivotTo(driver.Value)
		end
	end)
	trackConnection(state, connection)

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		driver,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Value = targetCFrame}
	)
	state.tweens[tween] = true
	tween:Play()
	task.wait(duration)
	state.tweens[tween] = nil

	disconnectConnection(state, connection)
	driver:Destroy()

	if state.destroyed or not item.Parent then
		return false
	end
	item:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
	return true
end

local function animateAssemblyPart(state, item, startCFrame, targetCFrame, duration, turns)
	if state.destroyed or not item or not item.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local progress = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	progress.Name = "WeaponWorkshopPlacementProgress"
	progress.Value = 0
	local startRotation = startCFrame - startCFrame.Position
	local targetRotation = targetCFrame - targetCFrame.Position
	local spinAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local connection
	connection = progress.Changed:Connect(function(alpha)
		if state.destroyed or not item.Parent then
			return
		end

		local position = startCFrame.Position:Lerp(targetCFrame.Position, alpha)
		local baseRotation = startRotation:Lerp(targetRotation, alpha)
		local spinAlpha = math.min(alpha / 0.8, 1)
		if alpha > 0.8 then
			spinAlpha = 1 - ((alpha - 0.8) / 0.2) * 0.2
		end
		local spinAngle = math.rad(360 * turns) * spinAlpha
		item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * baseRotation * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(spinAxis, spinAngle))
	end)
	trackConnection(state, connection)

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		progress,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Value = 1}
	)
	state.tweens[tween] = true
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
	state.tweens[tween] = nil

	disconnectConnection(state, connection)
	progress:Destroy()
	if state.destroyed or not item.Parent then
		return false
	end
	item:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
	return true
end

local function tweenItemsToCenter(state, items, centerPosition, duration)
	local active = {}

	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		if item.Parent then
			local driver = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
			driver.Value = item:GetPivot()
			local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(centerPosition) * item:GetPivot().Rotation
			local connection = driver:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
				if not state.destroyed and item.Parent then
					item:PivotTo(driver.Value)
				end
			end)
			trackConnection(state, connection)
			local tween = TweenService:Create(
				driver,
				TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
				{Value = targetCFrame}
			)
			state.tweens[tween] = true
			tween:Play()
			table.insert(active, {
				item = item,
				driver = driver,
				connection = connection,
				tween = tween,
				targetCFrame = targetCFrame,
			})
		end
	end

	task.wait(duration)

	for _, entry in ipairs(active) do
		state.tweens[entry.tween] = nil
		disconnectConnection(state, entry.connection)
		entry.driver:Destroy()
		if not state.destroyed and entry.item.Parent then
			entry.item:PivotTo(entry.targetCFrame)
		end
	end

	return not state.destroyed
end

local function scanPart(part, callback)
	if not part or not part.Parent then
		return
	end

	local success, touchingParts = pcall(function()
		return workspace:GetPartsInPart(part)
	end)
	if not success then
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] Failed overlap scan for %s", part:GetFullName()))
		return
	end

	local seen = {}
	for _, touchingPart in ipairs(touchingParts) do
		local item = getResourceItem(touchingPart)
		if item and not seen[item] then
			seen[item] = true
			callback(item)
		end
	end
end

local function isItemOverlappingPart(item, part)
	if not item or not item.Parent or not part or not part.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local success, touchingParts = pcall(function()
		return workspace:GetPartsInPart(part)
	end)
	if not success then
		return false
	end
	for _, touchingPart in ipairs(touchingParts) do
		if touchingPart:IsDescendantOf(item) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function rejectUntilItemLeaves(state, rejectedItems, item, part)
	if rejectedItems[item] then
		return
	end
	rejectedItems[item] = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while not state.destroyed
			and rejectedItems[item]
			and item.Parent
			and part.Parent
		do
			task.wait(0.1)
			if not isItemOverlappingPart(item, part) then
				rejectedItems[item] = nil
				return
			end
		end
		rejectedItems[item] = nil
	end)
end

local function markMachineOverlapsRejected(machine)
	scanPart(machine.submitPart, function(item)
		if getMaterialContribution(machine, item)
			and item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute) == nil
		then
			rejectUntilItemLeaves(
				machine.state,
				machine.rejectedItems,
				item,
				machine.submitPart
			)
		end
	end)
end

local function markAssemblyOverlapsRejected(assembly)
	scanPart(assembly.submitPart, function(item)
		local slot = assembly.slotByRequiredId[getItemId(item)]
		if slot
			and isItemOverlappingPart(item, assembly.submitPart)
			and item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute) == nil
		then
			rejectUntilItemLeaves(
				assembly.state,
				slot.rejectedItems,
				item,
				assembly.submitPart
			)
		end
	end)
end

local function getItemUnderRamTarget(item, submitPart, ramPart)
	local boundingCFrame, boundingSize = item:GetBoundingBox()
	local submitTop = submitPart.Position.Y + submitPart.Size.Y * 0.5
	local targetCenter = Vector3.new(
		ramPart.Position.X,
		submitTop + boundingSize.Y * 0.5,
		ramPart.Position.Z
	)
	return item:GetPivot() + (targetCenter - boundingCFrame.Position), submitTop
end

local function getSquishBaseline(item)
	local baseline = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(getBaseParts(item)) do
		table.insert(baseline, {
			part = part,
			size = part.Size,
			cframe = part.CFrame,
			transparency = part.Transparency,
		})
	end
	return baseline
end

local function tweenSquish(state, baseline, surfaceY, heightScale, fade, duration)
	local entries = {}

	for _, entry in ipairs(baseline) do
		local part = entry.part
		if part.Parent then
			local originalPosition = entry.cframe.Position
			local targetPosition = Vector3.new(
				originalPosition.X,
				surfaceY + (originalPosition.Y - surfaceY) * heightScale,
				originalPosition.Z
			)
			local properties = {
				Size = Vector3.new(
					entry.size.X,
					math.max(0.05, entry.size.Y * heightScale),
					entry.size.Z
				),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition) * entry.cframe.Rotation,
			}
			if fade then
				properties.Transparency = 1
			end
			local tween = startTween(
				state,
				part,
				TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
				properties
			)
			table.insert(entries, {
				part = part,
				tween = tween,
				properties = properties,
			})
		end
	end

	task.wait(duration)

	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		finishTween(state, entry.tween, entry.part, entry.properties)
	end
	return not state.destroyed
end

local function animateMaterialDeposit(state, machine, item)
	if state.destroyed or not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false
	end

	local targetCFrame, surfaceY = getItemUnderRamTarget(
		item,
		machine.submitPart,
		machine.ramPart
	)
	if not pivotTween(state, item, targetCFrame, Setting.MaterialCollectTime) then
		return false
	end

	local baseline = getSquishBaseline(item)
	local ramStart = machine.ramStartCFrame
	local ramBottom = ramStart.Position.Y - machine.ramPart.Size.Y * 0.5
	local stroke = math.max(
		Setting.PressOvertravel,
		ramBottom - surfaceY + Setting.PressOvertravel
	)
	local ramDown = ramStart + Vector3.new(0, -stroke, 0)
	local stage = Setting.QuickPressStage
	machine.ramPart.CFrame = ramStart

	local downProperties = {CFrame = ramDown}
	local ramDownTween = startTween(
		state,
		machine.ramPart,
		TweenInfo.new(stage.DownTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
		downProperties
	)
	if not tweenSquish(
		state,
		baseline,
		surfaceY,
		stage.HeightScale,
		stage.Fade == true,
		stage.DownTime
	) then
		if machine.ramPart.Parent then
			machine.ramPart.CFrame = ramStart
		end
		return false
	end
	if not finishTween(state, ramDownTween, machine.ramPart, downProperties) then
		return false
	end
	playEffect("树被撞击", machine.ramPart)

	if stage.HoldTime > 0 then
		task.wait(stage.HoldTime)
	end

	local upProperties = {CFrame = ramStart}
	local ramUpTween = startTween(
		state,
		machine.ramPart,
		TweenInfo.new(stage.UpTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		upProperties
	)
	task.wait(stage.UpTime)
	if not finishTween(state, ramUpTween, machine.ramPart, upProperties) then
		return false
	end
	if state.destroyed or not item.Parent then
		return false
	end

	discardLockedItem(state, item)
	ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
	return true
end

local function animateFinalPress(state, machine)
	if state.destroyed or not machine.ramPart or not machine.ramPart.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local surfaceY = machine.submitPart.Position.Y + machine.submitPart.Size.Y * 0.5
	local ramStart = machine.ramStartCFrame
	local ramBottom = ramStart.Position.Y - machine.ramPart.Size.Y * 0.5
	local stroke = math.max(
		Setting.PressOvertravel,
		ramBottom - surfaceY + Setting.PressOvertravel
	)
	local ramDown = ramStart + Vector3.new(0, -stroke, 0)
	machine.ramPart.CFrame = ramStart

	for _, stage in ipairs(Setting.PressStages) do
		if state.destroyed or not machine.ramPart.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local downProperties = {CFrame = ramDown}
		local ramDownTween = startTween(
			state,
			machine.ramPart,
			TweenInfo.new(stage.DownTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			downProperties
		)
		task.wait(stage.DownTime)
		if not finishTween(state, ramDownTween, machine.ramPart, downProperties) then
			return false
		end
		playEffect("树被撞击", machine.ramPart)

		if stage.HoldTime > 0 then
			task.wait(stage.HoldTime)
		end

		local upProperties = {CFrame = ramStart}
		local ramUpTween = startTween(
			state,
			machine.ramPart,
			TweenInfo.new(stage.UpTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			upProperties
		)
		task.wait(stage.UpTime)
		if not finishTween(state, ramUpTween, machine.ramPart, upProperties) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return not state.destroyed
end

local function updateRequirementUI(machine)
	if machine.requirementText and machine.requirementText.Parent then
		machine.requirementText.Text = string.format(
			"%d/%d",
			math.clamp(machine.acceptedAmount, 0, machine.requiredAmount),
			machine.requiredAmount
		)
	end
end

local function bindRequirementUI(machine)
	local board = machine.model
		and machine.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementBoardName)
		or nil
	local surface = board
		and board:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementSurfaceName)
		or nil
	local container = surface
		and surface:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementContainerName)
		or nil
	local template = container
		and container:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementTemplateName)
		or nil
	local icon = template
		and template:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementIconName)
		or nil
	local textLabel = template
		and template:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementTextName)
		or nil

	if not board
		or not board:IsA("BasePart")
		or not surface
		or not surface:IsA("SurfaceGui")
		or not container
		or not container:IsA("Frame")
		or not template
		or not template:IsA("Frame")
		or not icon
		or not icon:IsA("ImageLabel")
		or not textLabel
		or not textLabel:IsA("TextLabel")
	then
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s has an incomplete requirement board",
			machine.model:GetFullName()
		))
		return
	end

	local row = template:Clone()
	row.Name = "WeaponWorkshopRequirement"
	row.Visible = true
	local rowIcon = row:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementIconName)
	local rowText = row:FindFirstChild(Setting.RequirementTextName)
	if not rowIcon
		or not rowIcon:IsA("ImageLabel")
		or not rowText
		or not rowText:IsA("TextLabel")
	then
		row:Destroy()
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s requirement template cannot be cloned",
			machine.model:GetFullName()
		))
		return
	end

	local displayIcon = machine.requirement.DisplayIcon
	if not displayIcon and machine.requirement.MatchItemId then
		local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(machine.requirement.MatchItemId)
		displayIcon = lo and lo.icon or nil
	end
	if displayIcon then
		rowIcon.Image = displayIcon
	end

	template.Visible = false
	row.Parent = container
	machine.requirementRow = row
	machine.requirementText = rowText
	updateRequirementUI(machine)
end

local refreshMachine
local scanMachine
local runMachineQueue
local resetMachineOutput

refreshMachine = function(machine)
	if machine.powerIndicator and machine.powerIndicator.Parent then
		machine.powerIndicator.Color = machine.state.powered
			and Setting.PowerIndicatorOnColor
			or machine.powerIndicatorOffColor
	end
	if not machine.submitPart then
		return
	end
	local enabled = not machine.disabled
		and not machine.state.destroyed
		and machine.acceptedAmount < machine.requiredAmount
		and machine.pendingOutput == nil
	machine.submitPart.CanTouch = enabled
	updateRequirementUI(machine)
end

local function disconnectMachineOutputWatchers(machine)
	for _, connection in ipairs(machine.outputConnections) do
		disconnectConnection(machine.state, connection)
	end
	table.clear(machine.outputConnections)
end

resetMachineOutput = function(machine, output)
	if machine.pendingOutput ~= output then
		return
	end

	markMachineOverlapsRejected(machine)
	disconnectMachineOutputWatchers(machine)
	machine.pendingOutput = nil
	machine.acceptedAmount = 0
	refreshMachine(machine)
end

local function createMachineOutput(machine)
	local state = machine.state
	if state.destroyed then
		return
	end

	local success, output = pcall(function()
		return ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(machine.outputId, machine.startAttachment.WorldCFrame)
	end)
	if not success or not output then
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s could not create output %d: %s",
			machine.model:GetFullName(),
			machine.outputId,
			tostring(output)
		))
		machine.acceptedAmount = 0
		refreshMachine(machine)
		return
	end

	output:SetAttribute("WeaponWorkshopMachine", machine.index)
	machine.pendingOutput = output
	local record = lockItem(state, output)
	if not record then
		ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(output)
		machine.pendingOutput = nil
		machine.acceptedAmount = 0
		refreshMachine(machine)
		return
	end
	output:PivotTo(machine.startAttachment.WorldCFrame)

	local dragPlayerValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(output, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
	if dragPlayerValue then
		local dragConnection
		dragConnection = dragPlayerValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			local player = dragPlayerValue.Value
			if player and player:IsA("Player") then
				resetMachineOutput(machine, output)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(machine.outputConnections, trackConnection(state, dragConnection))
	end

	local ancestryConnection
	ancestryConnection = output.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, newParent)
		if newParent ~= workspace then
			resetMachineOutput(machine, output)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(machine.outputConnections, trackConnection(state, ancestryConnection))

	local reachedEnd = pivotTween(
		state,
		output,
		machine.endAttachment.WorldCFrame,
		Setting.OutputSlideTime
	)
	if not reachedEnd then
		return
	end

	unlockItem(state, output, false, nil)
	playEffect(Setting.MachineOutputSoundName, output)
end

local function attemptMachineSubmit(machine, item)
	local state = machine.state
	if state.destroyed or machine.disabled then
		return false
	end
	if machine.rejectedItems[item]
		or machine.pendingOutput
		or machine.acceptedAmount >= machine.requiredAmount
	then
		return false
	end

	local contribution = getMaterialContribution(machine, item)
	if not contribution or not hasValidSubmittingPlayer(item) then
		return false
	end
	if not state.powered then
		showUnpoweredTip(state, item)
		return false
	end
	local remainingAmount = machine.requiredAmount - machine.acceptedAmount
	local creditedAmount = math.min(contribution, remainingAmount)
	if creditedAmount <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if not reserveItem(item, machine.token) then
		return false
	end

	local record = lockItem(state, item)
	if not record then
		clearReservation(item, machine.token)
		return false
	end

	machine.acceptedAmount += creditedAmount
	table.insert(machine.queue, {
		item = item,
		creditedAmount = creditedAmount,
	})
	refreshMachine(machine)

	if not machine.processing then
		task.spawn(function()
			runMachineQueue(machine)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

scanMachine = function(machine)
	if machine.disabled
		or machine.state.destroyed
		or not machine.state.powered
		or machine.pendingOutput
	then
		return
	end
	scanPart(machine.submitPart, function(item)
		attemptMachineSubmit(machine, item)
	end)
end

runMachineQueue = function(machine)
	if machine.processing or machine.state.destroyed then
		return
	end
	machine.processing = true

	while not machine.state.destroyed and #machine.queue > 0 do
		local entry = table.remove(machine.queue, 1)
		local item = entry and entry.item or nil
		local consumed = false

		if item and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			local success, result = xpcall(function()
				return animateMaterialDeposit(machine.state, machine, item)
			end, debug.traceback)
			if success then
				consumed = result == true
			else
				warn(string.format(
					"[WeaponWorkshopService] Deposit failed in %s: %s",
					machine.model:GetFullName(),
					tostring(result)
				))
				if machine.ramPart.Parent then
					machine.ramPart.CFrame = machine.ramStartCFrame
				end
			end
		end

		if not consumed then
			machine.acceptedAmount = math.max(
				0,
				machine.acceptedAmount - (entry and entry.creditedAmount or 0)
			)
			if item then
				unlockItem(machine.state, item, true, machine.token)
			end
		end

		refreshMachine(machine)
		if machine.state.destroyed then
			break
		end
		scanMachine(machine)
	end

	if not machine.state.destroyed
		and #machine.queue == 0
		and machine.acceptedAmount >= machine.requiredAmount
		and not machine.pendingOutput
	then
		local success, result = xpcall(function()
			return animateFinalPress(machine.state, machine)
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not success or result ~= true then
			warn(string.format(
				"[WeaponWorkshopService] Final press failed in %s: %s",
				machine.model:GetFullName(),
				tostring(result)
			))
			if machine.ramPart.Parent then
				machine.ramPart.CFrame = machine.ramStartCFrame
			end
		end
		if not machine.state.destroyed then
			createMachineOutput(machine)
		end
	end

	machine.processing = false
	refreshMachine(machine)

	if not machine.state.destroyed and #machine.queue > 0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			runMachineQueue(machine)
		end)
	elseif not machine.state.destroyed
		and machine.acceptedAmount < machine.requiredAmount
	then
		scanMachine(machine)
	end
end

local function setPlaceholderVisible(slot, isVisible)
	for part, originalTransparency in pairs(slot.placeholderTransparency or {}) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.Transparency = isVisible and originalTransparency or 1
		end
	end
end

local function restoreAssemblyPlaceholders(assembly)
	for _, slot in ipairs(assembly.slots) do
		setPlaceholderVisible(slot, true)
	end
end

local refreshAssembly
local scanAssembly
local startAssembly
local resetAssemblyOutput

refreshAssembly = function(assembly)
	if not assembly.submitPart then
		return
	end
	local hasOpenSlot = false
	for _, slot in ipairs(assembly.slots) do
		if not slot.item then
			hasOpenSlot = true
			break
		end
	end
	assembly.submitPart.CanTouch = not assembly.disabled
		and not assembly.state.destroyed
		and not assembly.busy
		and assembly.pendingGun == nil
		and hasOpenSlot
end

local function disconnectAssemblyOutputWatchers(assembly)
	for _, connection in ipairs(assembly.outputConnections) do
		disconnectConnection(assembly.state, connection)
	end
	table.clear(assembly.outputConnections)
end

resetAssemblyOutput = function(assembly, gun)
	if assembly.pendingGun ~= gun then
		return
	end
	markAssemblyOverlapsRejected(assembly)
	disconnectAssemblyOutputWatchers(assembly)
	assembly.pendingGun = nil
	assembly.busy = false
	restoreAssemblyPlaceholders(assembly)
	refreshAssembly(assembly)
end

local function allAssemblySlotsFilled(assembly)
	for _, slot in ipairs(assembly.slots) do
		if not slot.item then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function maybeStartAssembly(assembly)
	if assembly.busy or assembly.placementCount > 0 or not allAssemblySlotsFilled(assembly) then
		return
	end
	assembly.busy = true
	refreshAssembly(assembly)
	task.spawn(function()
		startAssembly(assembly)
	end)
end

local function clearSlotWatch(assembly, slot)
	if slot.itemWatchConnection then
		disconnectConnection(assembly.state, slot.itemWatchConnection)
		slot.itemWatchConnection = nil
	end
end

local function attemptAssemblySubmit(assembly, slot, item)
	local state = assembly.state
	if assembly.disabled or state.destroyed then
		return false
	end
	if not isItemOverlappingPart(item, assembly.submitPart)
		or slot.rejectedItems[item]
		or assembly.busy
		or assembly.pendingGun
		or slot.item
	then
		return false
	end
	if not isLooseDraggableResource(item) or not hasValidSubmittingPlayer(item) then
		return false
	end
	if getItemId(item) ~= slot.requiredId then
		return false
	end
	local startCFrame = item:GetPivot()
	if not state.powered then
		showUnpoweredTip(state, item)
		return false
	end
	if not reserveItem(item, assembly.token) then
		return false
	end

	local record = lockItem(state, item)
	if not record then
		clearReservation(item, assembly.token)
		return false
	end

	slot.item = item
	slot.placing = true
	assembly.placementCount += 1
	setPlaceholderVisible(slot, false)
	playEffect(Setting.AssemblyPlacementSoundName, assembly.submitPart)

	local watchConnection
	watchConnection = item.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, newParent)
		if assembly.busy or slot.item ~= item then
			return
		end
		if newParent ~= workspace then
			clearSlotWatch(assembly, slot)
			unlockItem(state, item, false, assembly.token)
			slot.item = nil
			setPlaceholderVisible(slot, true)
			refreshAssembly(assembly)
		end
	end)
	slot.itemWatchConnection = trackConnection(state, watchConnection)

	task.spawn(function()
		local placed = animateAssemblyPart(
			state,
			item,
			startCFrame,
			slot.placeholderCFrame,
			Setting.AssemblyPlacementTime,
			Setting.AssemblyPlacementSpinTurns
		)
		assembly.placementCount = math.max(0, assembly.placementCount - 1)
		slot.placing = false

		if not placed then
			if slot.item == item then
				clearSlotWatch(assembly, slot)
				slot.item = nil
				setPlaceholderVisible(slot, true)
				unlockItem(state, item, true, assembly.token)
				refreshAssembly(assembly)
			end
			return
		end

		maybeStartAssembly(assembly)
	end)

	refreshAssembly(assembly)
	return true
end

scanAssembly = function(assembly)
	if assembly.disabled
		or assembly.state.destroyed
		or not assembly.state.powered
		or assembly.busy
		or assembly.pendingGun
	then
		return
	end
	scanPart(assembly.submitPart, function(item)
		local slot = assembly.slotByRequiredId[getItemId(item)]
		if slot then
			attemptAssemblySubmit(assembly, slot, item)
		end
	end)
end

startAssembly = function(assembly)
	local state = assembly.state
	if assembly.placementCount > 0 then
		return
	end
	task.wait(Setting.AssemblyDelay)
	if state.destroyed then
		return
	end

	local items = {}
	for _, slot in ipairs(assembly.slots) do
		if not slot.item or not slot.item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			if slot.item then
				clearSlotWatch(assembly, slot)
				state.lockedItems[slot.item] = nil
				clearReservation(slot.item, assembly.token)
				slot.item = nil
			end
			setPlaceholderVisible(slot, true)
			assembly.busy = false
			refreshAssembly(assembly)
			return
		end
		table.insert(items, slot.item)
	end

	local centerPosition = assembly.placeholderCenterPosition + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)
	if not tweenItemsToCenter(
		state,
		items,
		centerPosition,
		Setting.AssemblyTweenTime
	) then
		return
	end

	playEffect(Setting.AssemblyCompleteSoundName, assembly.submitPart)

	for _, slot in ipairs(assembly.slots) do
		local item = slot.item
		clearSlotWatch(assembly, slot)
		slot.item = nil
		if item then
			discardLockedItem(state, item)
			ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
		end
	end

	local success, gun = pcall(function()
		return ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(
			Setting.RifleId,
			CFrame.new(centerPosition + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
		)
	end)
	if not success or not gun then
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] Failed to create rifle %d: %s",
			Setting.RifleId,
			tostring(gun)
		))
		assembly.busy = false
		restoreAssemblyPlaceholders(assembly)
		refreshAssembly(assembly)
		return
	end

	gun:SetAttribute("WeaponWorkshopProduct", true)
	assembly.pendingGun = gun
	assembly.busy = false

	local primaryPart = gun.PrimaryPart
	if primaryPart then
		primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		primaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	local dragPlayerValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, DragItemValue.dragPlayer)
	if dragPlayerValue then
		local dragConnection
		dragConnection = dragPlayerValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			local player = dragPlayerValue.Value
			if player and player:IsA("Player") then
				resetAssemblyOutput(assembly, gun)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(assembly.outputConnections, trackConnection(state, dragConnection))
	end

	local ancestryConnection
	ancestryConnection = gun.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, newParent)
		if newParent ~= workspace then
			resetAssemblyOutput(assembly, gun)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(assembly.outputConnections, trackConnection(state, ancestryConnection))

	refreshAssembly(assembly)
end

local function bindMachine(state, frame, machineDefinition, index)
	local machine = {
		state = state,
		index = index,
		outputId = machineDefinition.OutputId,
		requirement = machineDefinition.Requirement,
		requiredAmount = tonumber(
			machineDefinition.Requirement and machineDefinition.Requirement.RequiredAmount
		) or 0,
		queue = {},
		acceptedAmount = 0,
		processing = false,
		pendingOutput = nil,
		outputConnections = {},
		requirementRow = nil,
		requirementText = nil,
		powerIndicator = nil,
		powerIndicatorOffColor = nil,
		rejectedItems = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
		token = string.format("%s:machine:%d", state.token, index),
		disabled = false,
	}
	table.insert(state.machines, machine)

	machine.model = frame and frame:FindFirstChild(machineDefinition.ModelName) or nil
	machine.submitPart = machine.model and machine.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.SubmissionName, true) or nil
	machine.po
